purpose: Monte Carlo draws: one global .param site shared by two elements, one per-element site.

oracle.derivation: v(b) = (rv + d)/(2k + d), rv ~ N(1k, 50) read by both resistors, d ~ N(0, 50): to first order mean 0.5 and sigma = sqrt((50/2k)^2 + (50/4k)^2) = 27.95 mV; independent draws per use would give 21.7 mV.

notes: Limits are about six standard errors of 2000 trials. The seed is fixed, so repeat runs are bit-identical.
